topic.title: Work as a Subject-Matter Expert
topic.shortdesc: Users with the Subject-Matter Expert platform user role use to review shared content, add feedback, and suggest changes in a review task. They can also create and own review tasks.

body.p: This section explains the main tasks for users with the Subject-Matter Expert platform user role in .

As a user with the Subject-Matter Expert platform user role, you work with review tasks. You can open shared content, read it in context, add comments, suggest edits, and reply to discussions. You can also create your own review tasks.

ul.li: Open review tasks that task owners shared with them.
Read and navigate the documents included in a review.
Reply to comments and take part in discussions.

section.title: How to use this section
section.p: Start with Review tasks overview to understand how review tasks work. If you need to create or manage your own task, continue with Creating review tasks. For day-to-day review work, see Reviewing content, Commenting and suggesting changes, and Communicating with authors.
